preconditions.description: The dimensions of the matrix must be within the range of 1 to 100.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in row) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: All characters in the matrix must be lowercase alphabetical characters.

preconditions.expression: len(matrix) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The matrix must have exactly n rows and each row must have exactly m columns.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of palindromic paths modulo 10^9 + 7.
